title: JSFL timeline missing moveLayer and duplicateLayer methods
description: packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts exports moveLayer (line 161) and duplicateLayer (line 148), but the JSFL JsflTimeline facade in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts has no moveLayer() or duplicateLayer() method. Flash 8 JSFL scripts that call timeline.moveLayer(from, to) or timeline.duplicateLayer() fail with TypeError. Fix: add moveLayer(fromIndex, toIndex, numLayers?) and duplicateLayer(layerIndex?) methods to the JsflTimeline class, delegating to the model functions.
